scope_limits.part_a_is_an_identity: classes_nonconstant_OPTIMAL_VALUE = 0 is arithmetic, not measurement: min(spectrum) IS the optimal value by construction. ORION proves its part (a) the same way. The informative existence result is the bulk_only control.
scope_limits.orion_checks_more_of_part_a: ORION verifies FIVE predicates split 0/92 (is donor optimal; improvement >= k for k=-3..3; optimal cost value; number of optimal frames; full achievable-cost multiset). This experiment checked only the optimal value; the number-of-optimal-options check was launched and killed while CPU-starved.
scope_limits.exact_collisions_need_low_entropy: n=5 / 120 options / opt3 / 600 circuits gave ZERO bulk x spectrum collisions. Exact-collision analysis is only feasible for small option sets and few terms - NOT the regime Symphony/PCOAST target (up to 930 qubits, 8241 Pauli terms). This is a toy-scale existence demonstration of the phenomenon, not evidence about production-scale compilation.
scope_limits.input_family_is_narrow: terms drawn with P(I)=2/5 per letter; every circuit containing a weight-1 term is excluded. Whether the separation survives on HamLib Trotter steps, UCCSD or QAOA is untested.
scope_limits.sample_not_exhaustive: ORION's 92 classes partition the COMPLETE 715-type space. These class counts are properties of a finite sample at one seed and grow with sample size; the effective independent count is well below the nominal class count (median 2 distinct argmin sets per class).
